Methodology

Counts come from Celestrak's SATCAT catalog, filtered to records whereOBJECT_TYPE = PAY — i.e. actual spacecraft, excluding rocket bodies and debris. Each record's LAUNCH_DATE year and OWNER code are then tallied. This reflects every catalogued payload ever launched, not just objects currently in orbit — it is independent of the catalog selected on the Ground Track page.
